defs.def: a long curved fruit with a thick yellow skin and soft flesh, that grows on trees in hot countries 香蕉

ex.s: My husband had banana pudding for his birthday.
ex.t: 我丈夫生日那天吃的是香蕉布丁。

ex.s: Why did the author's husband have banana pudding for his birthday?
ex.t: 为什么作者丈夫生日那天吃的是香蕉布丁？

ex.s: 16．（30分）I was ready to pay for my bananas at the grocery one night， when fear seized me． My wallet was gone． I could only have left it on the G9 bus， which was now speeding in the dark to some（1）     station．
When combined with berries or slices of other fruits, frozen bananas make an excellent base for thick, cooling fruit shakes and low fat “ice cream”.
ex.t: 冷冻香蕉与浆果或其他水果片搭配，是制作浓稠、清凉果昔和低脂“冰淇淋”的绝佳基底。

ex.s: For this purpose, select ripe bananas for freezing as they are much sweeter.
ex.t: 为此目的，请选择成熟的香蕉进行冷冻，因为它们更甜。

ex.s: If you like, a squeeze of fresh lemon juice on the bananas will prevent them turning brown.
ex.t: 如果你愿意，在香蕉上挤一点鲜柠檬汁可以防止它们变褐。

ex.s: Frozen bananas will last several weeks, depending on their ripeness and the temperature of the freezer.
ex.t: 冷冻香蕉可以保存数周，具体取决于它们的成熟度和冰箱温度。

ex.s: If you have a juicer, you can simply feed in frozen bananas and some berries or sliced fruit.
ex.t: 如果你有榨汁机，只需投入冷冻香蕉和一些浆果或切片水果。

ex.s: This makes a fun activity for a children’s party; they love feeding the fruit and frozen bananas into the top of the machine and watching the ice cream come out below.
ex.t: 这对儿童派对来说是个有趣的活动；他们喜欢把水果和冷冻香蕉从机器顶端投入，看着冰淇淋从下方出来。

ex.s: Why is fresh lemon juice used in freezing bananas?
ex.t: 为什么冷冻香蕉时要使用新鲜柠檬汁？

ex.s: The funniest moment was when someone watching the race offered me a banana - a real treat for a running gorilla!
ex.t: 坐在一个旧手提箱上，当人们从酒吧回家的时候。

ex.s: (Student F) Yesterday, I stepped on a banana skin and fell.
ex.t: 她一点头绪都没有，更别说解决办法了。

ex.s: I tried nofat, low-fat, 5:2, only bananas, no bananas—I almost went bananas, too.
ex.t: 婚礼招待会在酒吧的花园里，\/在美丽的公园里举行。

ex.s: The students grow bananas on the farm for .
ex.t: 他撞到了一个路障，摔倒在地，但被其他跑步者扶了起来。

ex.s: The money they get from these bananas goes towards for students from poor areas.
ex.t: 它是建立在激情和爱国主义的基础上的。\/在这个基础上，它让人感到充满活力。
